name: Typeform
whatYouLose: Advanced branching logic and a large integration marketplace
Enterprise compliance, permissions, and response analytics
prompt: Build a conversational form builder for one workspace. Admins create forms with short text, long text, email, number, single-choice, multi-choice, rating, and consent questions. Render one question per screen with keyboard-first navigation, progress, conditional jumps, required validation, draft persistence, and an embeddable public form. Store forms and responses in SQLite, provide CSV export and simple completion/drop-off analytics, add a password-protected admin area, and include honeypot plus rate limiting. Use Astro SSR and vanilla JavaScript with no client framework.
notes: A focused lead form or research questionnaire is straightforward. The complexity arrives when every team needs its own branching grammar and integrations.
